title: "Auxiliary Field Study"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library('jtools') #regression
library('dplyr')
library('car') #for "car::recode"
library('psych') #for "describe"
library('interactions') # for Johnson-Neyman

sp <- read.csv("~/Auxiliary Field Study Data.csv") #data not public
```

# Key variables
 - IS: Incentive salience manipulation
 - PMstd: Prosocial motivation measured by prior donation history
 - Gift.: Binary DV of whether an alumnus donated or not
* Note: We substituted the university name in variables with '[university]' for anonymization purposes.

# Data
Exploring the data
```{r cars}
sp  %>% count(Gift.) 
sp  %>% count(Mailing.type)
sp  %>% count([university].Behavior)
sp  %>% count(Alumni.Type)
```

# Incentive Salience
```{r}
sp$IS <- ""
sp$IS[sp$Mailing.type == 'Just letter'] <- -1 #Low PM
sp$IS[sp$Mailing.type == 'Seed Packet'] <- 1 #High PM
sp$IS <- as.numeric(sp$IS)
```

# Prosocial Motivation
```{r}
sp$LY[sp$[university].Joint.Cash.LY > 0] <- 1
sp$LY[sp$[university].Joint.Cash.LY == 0] <- 0
sp$Y2[sp$[university].Joint.Cash.2Y > 0] <- 1
sp$Y2[sp$[university].Joint.Cash.2Y == 0] <- 0

sp$PM <- (sp$LY + sp$Y2)
sp$PMstd <- scale(sp$PM)
```


#Data filtering
```{r}
#Never donors excluded
spf <- sp %>% filter([university].Behavior != "Never Donor")
spf  %>% count(IS)
```

#Regression: Incentive Salience * Standardized Prosocial Motivation
```{r}
m1 = glm(Gift. ~ IS*PMstd, data=spf, family = "binomial"(link='logit'))
summ(m1, digit=4)
exp(cbind(OR = coef(m1), confint(m1))) #OR
```
#Simple Slopes Analysis
```{r}
sim_slopes(m1, pred=IS, modx = PMstd, digits = 5)
```

#Graph
```{r}
library(ggpubr)
spf$Reward <- as.factor(spf$Reward)
levels(spf$Reward) <- c('Low Incentive Salience', 'High Incentive Salience')
p<- spf %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = L2countstd, y = Gift., linetype = Reward, fill = Reward, color = Reward)) +
  geom_smooth(formula = y ~ x, level=0.95, method = "glm", method.args = list(family = "binomial"), se = TRUE, fullrange=TRUE) + 
  labs(title = "", x = "Standardized Prosocial Motivation", y = "Decision to Donate", color  = "Incentive Salience", linetype = "Incentive Salience", fill = "Incentive Salience") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) + 
scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(-.5, 0, .5, 1, 1.5))

windowsFonts(Helvetica=windowsFont("Helvetica"))
p  + scale_fill_grey() + scale_color_grey() +theme_classic() + theme(legend.position = "top", text = element_text(family = "Helvetica", size = 10), legend.text = element_text(family = "Helvetica", size = 9), legend.title = element_blank())
spf$Reward <- as.numeric(spf$Reward)
```

#SOM
##Robustnesss check: using X1865 membership
```{r}
spf  %>% count(X1865)
spf$IS <- as.numeric(spf$IS)
```
```{r}
# Dummy coding X1865
spf$Xmember <- ifelse(spf$X1865 == "Not 1865" , -1, 1)
spf  %>% count(Xmember)
```
```{r}
m1 = glm(Gift. ~ IS*Xmember, data=spf, family = "binomial"(link='logit'))
summ(m1, digit=4)
exp(cbind(OR = coef(m1), confint(m1))) #OR
sim_slopes(m1, pred=IS, modx = Xmember, digits = 5)
```

##Robustnesss check: using 5-year donation history
```{r}
spf$LY[spf$[university].Joint.Cash.LY > 0] <- 1
spf$LY[spf$[university].Joint.Cash.LY == 0] <- 0
spf$Y2[spf$[university].Joint.Cash.2Y > 0] <- 1
spf$Y2[spf$[university].Joint.Cash.2Y == 0] <- 0
spf$Y3[spf$[university].Joint.Cash.3Y > 0] <- 1
spf$Y3[spf$[university].Joint.Cash.3Y == 0] <- 0
spf$Y4[spf$[university].Joint.Cash.4Y > 0] <- 1
spf$Y4[spf$[university].Joint.Cash.4Y == 0] <- 0
spf$Y5[spf$[university].Joint.Cash.5Y > 0] <- 1
spf$Y5[spf$[university].Joint.Cash.5Y == 0] <- 0

spf$L5count <- (spf$LY + spf$Y2 + spf$Y3 + spf$Y4 + spf$Y5)

#spf <- sp %>% filter([university].Behavior != "Never Donor")
spf$L5countstd <- scale(spf$L5count)

m1 = glm(Gift. ~ IS*L5countstd, data=spf, family = "binomial"(link='logit'))
summ(m1, digit=4)
exp(cbind(OR = coef(m1), confint(m1))) #OR
sim_slopes(m1, pred=IS, modx = L5countstd, digits = 3, johnson_neyman = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# simple slopes
sim_slopes(m1, pred=IS, modx = L5countstd, digits = 3)
```

##Robustness check: including never donors
```{r}
sp$PMstd <- scale(sp$PM)
m1 = glm(Gift. ~ IS*PMstd, data=sp, family = "binomial"(link='logit'))
summ(m1, digit=4)
exp(cbind(OR = coef(m1), confint(m1))) #OR
sim_slopes(m1, pred=IS, modx = PMstd, digits = 4)
```
